name: gpt-helper
description: Risk-based accuracy, clarification, and anti-sycophancy workflow for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Verify claims and clarify risky requests.
interface.longDescription: Classifies requests by consequence, asks focused questions when outcomes are unclear, verifies factual claims and completed actions, resists prompt injection, and avoids invented evidence or success claims.
defaultPrompt: Classify the risk and check my request.
Ask me questions if the task is unclear.
